source.name: IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint transit calls
source.publisher: International Monetary Fund / UN Global Platform
source.attribution: IMF PortWatch (portwatch.imf.org), based on UN Global Platform AIS data. Consult portwatch.imf.org for upstream terms of use.

units.cargo: vessel transit calls per day (container + dryBulk + generalCargo + roro)
units.total: vessel transit calls per day (all classes)
units.capContainer: aggregate capacity of transiting container vessels, deadweight tonnage (DWT)
units.capDryBulk: aggregate capacity of transiting dry-bulk vessels, DWT
units.capGeneralCargo: aggregate capacity of transiting general-cargo vessels, DWT
units.capRoro: aggregate capacity of transiting ro-ro vessels, DWT
units.capTanker: aggregate capacity of transiting tanker vessels, DWT
